summary_1line: Shiva extols Krishna (Vasudeva) as the supreme cosmic being and foretells his birth in the Yadu lineage to aid the gods.

image_candidates.scene_text: Mahadeva stands before assembled rishis, praising the radiant Krishna who shines like a second sun with weapons and Garuda on his banner.
Within the vast cosmic form of Krishna, Brahma and Shiva dwell while gods, worlds, and stars emerge from his body.
The lineage of kings unfolds from Manu to Yadu as sages listen to Shiva foretell Krishna’s future birth.
